description: R08 Host ScreenBuffer cursor-movement checkpoint: safe Rust owns portable CUU/CUD/CUF/CUB/CNL/CPL/HPR/VPR movement and DEC margin clamping semantics.

entries.notes: Safe Rust clamps CUU/CUD to DECSTBM when a movement from outside crosses into or through the vertical margin region.
CUU/CUD movement that remains wholly outside DECSTBM is not spuriously clamped into the margin region.
Movement starting exactly on the top/bottom vertical margins clamps outward motion while permitting inward motion.
With DECLRMM active, CUF/CUB clamp large movements to the right/left horizontal margin respectively.
Horizontal movement that stays outside DECLRMM margins remains outside rather than snapping into the margin region.
Movement exactly on horizontal margins clamps outward motion while allowing movement back into the region.
CNL/CPL use vertical-margin clamping and reset X to the active left horizontal margin only when starting inside the vertical region; outside the region they reset to column zero.
HPR/VPR intentionally ignore DEC margins and clamp only to the full row/viewport bounds, including oversized counts.
